elements.requirement: A conveyance to a purchaser of a legal estate in land overreaches any equitable interest or power affecting that estate, whether or not the purchaser has notice of it, if the conveyance is made under powers conferred by the Settled Land Act 1925 or additional powers under a settlement, the equitable interest or power is capable of being overreached thereby, and statutory requirements regarding payment of capital money under the settlement are complied with.
elements.quote: the conveyance is made under the powers conferred by the Settled Land Act, 1925, or any additional powers conferred by a settlement, and the equitable interest or power is capable of being overreached thereby, and the statutory requirements respecting the payment of capital money arising under the settlement are complied with

elements.requirement: A conveyance to a purchaser of a legal estate in land overreaches any equitable interest or power affecting that estate, whether or not the purchaser has notice of it, if the conveyance is made by trustees of land, the equitable interest or power is at the date of conveyance capable of being overreached by the trustees under subsection (2) of this section or independently, and the requirements of section 27 regarding the payment of capital money are complied with.
elements.quote: the conveyance is made by trustees of land and the equitable interest or power is at the date of the conveyance capable of being overreached by such trustees under the provisions of subsection (2) of this section or independently of that subsection, and the requirements of section 27 of this Act respecting the payment of capital money arising on such a conveyance are complied with

elements.requirement: A conveyance to a purchaser of a legal estate in land overreaches any equitable interest or power affecting that estate, whether or not the purchaser has notice of it, if the conveyance is made by a mortgagee or personal representative exercising paramount powers, the equitable interest or power is capable of being overreached by the conveyance, and any capital money arising from the transaction is paid to the mortgagee or personal representative.
elements.quote: the conveyance is made by a mortgagee or personal representative in the exercise of his paramount powers, and the equitable interest or power is capable of being overreached by such conveyance, and any capital money arising from the transaction is paid to the mortgagee or personal representative

elements.requirement: A conveyance to a purchaser of a legal estate in land overreaches any equitable interest or power affecting that estate, whether or not the purchaser has notice of it, if the conveyance is made under a court order, the equitable interest or power is bound by that order, and any capital money arising is paid into or in accordance with the order of the court.
elements.quote: the conveyance is made under an order of the court and the equitable interest or power is bound by such order, and any capital money arising from the transaction is paid into, or in accordance with the order of, the court

elements.requirement: An equitable interest in land subject to a trust of land that remains in or reverts to the settlor is overreached by a conveyance (subject to any contrary intention) if it would be so overreached were it an interest under the trust.
elements.quote: An equitable interest in land subject to a trust of land which remains in, or is to revert to, the settlor shall (subject to any contrary intention) be overreached by the conveyance if it would be so overreached were it an interest under the trust.

elements.requirement: Where a legal estate is subject to a trust of land and a conveyance is made after the commencement of the Act by trustees who are two or more individuals approved or appointed by the court (or their successors in office) or a trust corporation, any equitable interest or power having priority to the trust is overreached notwithstanding any contrary stipulation, and takes effect according to priority against proceeds of sale and income until sale.
elements.quote: any equitable interest or power having priority to the trust shall, notwithstanding any stipulation to the contrary, be overreached by the conveyance, and shall, according to its priority, take effect as if created or arising by means of a primary trust affecting the proceeds of sale and the income of the land until sale

elements.requirement: An equitable interest protected by a deposit of documents relating to the affected legal estate is excepted from being overreached under subsection (2).
elements.quote: Any equitable interest protected by a deposit of documents relating to the legal estate affected

elements.requirement: The benefit of any covenant or agreement restrictive of the user of land is excepted from being overreached under subsection (2).
elements.quote: The benefit of any covenant or agreement restrictive of the user of land

elements.requirement: Any equitable easement, liberty, or privilege over or affecting land is excepted from being overreached under subsection (2).
elements.quote: Any easement, liberty, or privilege over or affecting land and being merely an equitable interest (in this Act referred to as an “equitable easement”)

elements.requirement: The benefit of an estate contract, including an option to purchase, right of pre-emption, or like right, is excepted from being overreached under subsection (2).
elements.quote: The benefit of any contract (in this Act referred to as an “estate contract”) to convey or create a legal estate, including a contract conferring either expressly or by statutory implication a valid option to purchase, a right of pre-emption, or any other like right

elements.requirement: An equitable interest protected by registration under the Land Charges Act 1925 is excepted from being overreached under subsection (2), unless it is an annuity within the meaning of Part II of that Act, or a limited owner's charge or general equitable charge within the meaning of that Act.
elements.quote: Any equitable interest protected by registration under the Land Charges Act, 1925, other than— (a) an annuity within the meaning of Part II. of that Act; (b) a limited owner’s charge or a general equitable charge within the meaning of that Act.

elements.requirement: A person entitled to an equitable charge is not deprived of any rights or remedies for enforcing the charge, subject to the protection afforded to the purchaser of a legal estate.
elements.quote: Subject to the protection afforded by this section to the purchaser of a legal estate, nothing contained in this section shall deprive a person entitled to an equitable charge of any of his rights or remedies for enforcing the same.

elements.requirement: A purchaser of a legal estate takes subject to certain pre-commencement interests (namely a restrictive covenant or agreement, an equitable easement, an interest under a puisne mortgage unless acquired under a post-commencement transfer, or the benefit of an estate contract unless acquired under a post-commencement conveyance) only if the purchaser has notice of them, and those interests are not overreached under this section.
elements.quote: a purchaser of a legal estate shall only take subject thereto if he has notice thereof, and the same are not overreached under the provisions contained or in the manner referred to in this section

thresholds.quote: two or more individuals approved or appointed by the court or the successors in office of the individuals so approved or appointed
